# Jeremiah 21 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** This is the message the LORD gave Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malchijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to talk with him. They said,

**2** "Please ask the LORD to help us! Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking. Maybe the LORD will do one of His miracles and make him go away."

**3** But Jeremiah replied, "Go back to Zedekiah and tell him this:

**4** The LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am going to make your weapons useless! The weapons you're using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians besieging you outside the walls — I'm going to pile them up right here in the middle of this city.

**5** And then I Myself will fight against you — with My mighty hand and powerful arm, full of anger, fury, and burning rage.

**6** I will strike down everyone in this city — people and animals alike — with a devastating plague.

**7** Then, says the LORD, I will hand over King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone who survives the plague, war, and famine to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and to their enemies who want them dead. He will slaughter them without mercy, without pity, without compassion.

**8** And tell the people of this city: The LORD says: Look, I'm giving you a choice — life or death.

**9** Anyone who stays in this city will die — by war, starvation, or disease. But anyone who goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians will live. Their lives will be their reward.

**10** I have made up My mind to bring disaster on this city, not blessing, says the LORD. It will be handed over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it to the ground.

**11** And say this to the royal family of Judah: Listen to the LORD's message!

**12** Family of David, this is what the LORD says: Give justice to the people every morning! Rescue victims from their oppressors — or else My anger will burn like an unquenchable fire because of all the evil you've done.

**13** "I am against you, Jerusalem, you who sit in the valley on the rocky plateau," declares the LORD. "You think, 'No one can attack us here! No one can break through our defenses!'

**14** But I will punish you for the consequences of what you've done," says the LORD. "I will set fire to your forests, and it will burn up everything around you."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **21:2**: Zedekiah is hoping for a miracle like the one that saved Jerusalem from Assyria a century earlier. But God's answer is the opposite of what he wants to hear — God is fighting for the other side.

- **21:8-9**: This is the most politically dangerous thing Jeremiah ever says. He's telling people to surrender to the enemy — which is textbook treason. But it's God's instruction.

- **21:13**: Jerusalem's residents were confident in their city's defenses. They forgot that walls don't matter when God Himself is the one bringing judgment.

— PNEUMA
